description: Unit test class 'AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest' for testing abstract leave allocation services in the OrangeHRM leave module. Contains test methods with data providers to validate time duration calculations and hour additions.

classes.name: AbstractLeaveAllocationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the AbstractLeaveAllocationService functionalities within the OrangeHRM leave module.
